analysis.title: AI Agent Engineer, Cloud Infrastructure
analysis.fit_rationale: The candidate has strong infrastructure, performance engineering, and Python automation experience, plus practical AI projects (agentic pipeline, lakehouse with Text-to-SQL, RAG). However, the role requires 5 years of translating user requirements into workflows and 1 year of building AI agents with commercial offerings; the candidate's AI work is largely project-based or research, not production enterprise AI agent deployment. Cloud infrastructure focus is partially met (AWS project, but no GCP/Azure/Cloudflare production experience).
strengths: Expert-level Python, SQL, ETL, and capacity planning/forecasting
Hands-on AWS project (S3/Glue/Athena/Bedrock) with Text-to-SQL agent
Built a Python agentic job-search pipeline using FAISS, LLM scoring, MCP
Strong performance engineering and observability background (Dynatrace, CA APM)
Experience with large-scale data migrations (Sabre) and cost optimization
Proven ability to explain technical work to non-technical stakeholders (consulting, training)
gaps: No demonstrated production multi-agent workflow deployment in enterprise setting
Lack of 5 years of explicit requirements-to-workflow translation; more infrastructure/data engineering
No GCP, Azure, or Cloudflare production experience; AWS only (project-level)
Cloud networking, identity, and secrets management not evidenced
No government/defense or intelligence domain experience
tailoring_plan: 1. Highlight the AWS lakehouse project as evidence of cloud infrastructure as code and Text-to-SQL agent. 2. Emphasize the agentic job-search pipeline as a multi-agent workflow with handoff and context sharing. 3. Frame current role's AI-assisted reporting as production workflow automation. 4. Address cloud gaps by noting foundational Azure knowledge and willingness to learn GCP/Cloudflare. 5. Prepare to discuss how to translate stakeholder requirements into workflows, using consulting experience. 6. Emphasize cost optimization and performance engineering as transferable to run cost control. 7
